DATE
Thursday, February 12, 2026 at 9 a.m. ET
CALL PARTICIPANTS
Chief Executive Officer — Harshita Agadi
Chief Financial Officer — Giles Goodburn
Chief Operating Officer — Joshua Overholt
TAKEAWAYS
New Business ACV
-- $152 million in the quarter, up 11% from Q4 2024, with full-year 2025 new business ACV at $517 million, a 6% increase.
Qualified ACV Pipeline
-- $3.2 billion, up 4%, with the Government segment pipeline growing 29%, and the in-year 2026 pipeline nearly double its level from the start of 2025.
Segment New Business ACV
-- Full-year Government up 50%, and Transportation up 14%. Commercial down 15%. New capability ACV to existing clients up 60%.
Adjusted Revenue
-- $3.04 billion in 2025 versus $3.18 billion in 2024, a decrease of 4.2%.
Adjusted EBITDA
-- $164 million in 2025, up from $124 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 5.4%, up 150 basis points year over year, and at the high end of guidance.
Q4 Adjusted EBITDA Margin
-- 6.5%, an increase of 250 basis points from Q4 2024, and 130 basis points sequentially from Q3.
Commercial Segment Results
-- Full-year adjusted revenue was $1.5 billion, down 5.9%. Adjusted EBITDA margin of 10.2%, down 30 basis points, primarily due to volume declines among the largest commercial clients, with remaining top 10 clients growing in aggregate.
Government Segment Results
-- Full-year adjusted revenue $922 million, down 0.3%, as new business revenue surpassed lost business but was offset by winding down large implementation projects. Segment Q4 revenue grew 1.8%. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 24%, up 270 basis points, driven by AI and efficiency programs.
Transportation Segment Results
-- Full-year adjusted revenue was $609 million, up 3.9%. Adjusted EBITDA was $18 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 3%, a rise of 300 basis points, aided by equipment sales and a transit contract amendment.
Unallocated Costs
-- $229 million for the year, a decline of 10.2%, attributed to efficiency programs and legal cost recovery, more than offsetting increased U.S. employee healthcare claims.
Adjusted Free Cash Flow
-- Negative $130 million for the year; positive $28 million in Q4, with collections from delayed government contracts expected in Q1 or early Q2 2026.
Net Leverage Ratio
-- Decreased to 2.8 turns by year-end, primarily due to higher EBITDA.
Capital Expenditure
-- 3.4% of revenue, in line with internal expectations.
Portfolio Rationalization
-- Active review and acceleration of business unit divestiture, categorizing each as "fix," "sell," or "grow." Proceeds prioritized first for debt reduction, then additional uses.
Cost Structure Discipline
-- Plan to lower corporate overhead, trim SG&A, and optimize technology expenses as share of revenue; management stated, "At current levels, corporate overhead and technology expense as a percentage of revenue must come down."
Leadership Structure
-- CEO Harshita Agadi plans to appoint a single commercial leader following interim personal oversight; sales team engagement altered with a direct weekly revenue focus.
Margin Outlook
-- Leadership targets a medium-term margin of 8%-10%, with CEO Agadi stating, "in a business in our sector, which is BPO, KPO, I think at a minimum we need to start really clipping at between an 8-10% margin in the medium term, maybe even higher."
AI and Technology Positioning
-- Roughly 15%-20% of revenue identified as exposed to potential AI disruption, with proactive initiatives to partner with smaller AI firms and enhance product differentiation and client "moat."
Capital Allocation Considerations
-- Open market bond buybacks under consideration given current trading levels, with CFO Goodburn stating that debt paydown may be favored over equity repurchases depending on yield calculations.
2026 Guidance Timing
-- No formal guidance for 2026 provided; full updates on portfolio strategy and financial outlook to be shared with Q1 results in early May.
Analyst Day Announcement
-- Planned upcoming Analyst Day in New York City to further detail strategic priorities, portfolio plans, and leadership direction.

INDUSTRY GLOSSARY
ACV (Annual Contract Value)
: The annualized value of new contracts signed during a reporting period, reflecting committed recurring revenue.
TCV (Total Contract Value)
: The aggregate value of all contracts entered into during the period, including both one-time and recurring revenues across their lifespans.
Pipeline
: The value of potential contracts in active negotiation, not yet signed, tracked for future business projections.
BPO (Business Process Outsourcing)
: Contracted services involving the management of business operations and processes by a third-party provider.
KPO (Knowledge Process Outsourcing)
: Outsourcing services that require advanced analytical and technical skills, typically involving the provision of domain-based processes and high-value decision-making.
SG&A (Selling, General, and Administrative expenses)
: Overhead costs not directly attributable to specific products or services but necessary for business operations.
